home.pill: Company memory for small and midsize teams
home.title: What you promised your clients,
home.lead: Leon connects to your tools and to your conversations with AI assistants. It stores everything as written, keeps your AI conversations visible only to you, and answers by citing the source. When nothing answers the question, it says so.
home.toolsLead: Meetings, tickets, CRM, support, pages, email. Leon picks up what changed every 15 minutes, through an API key or OAuth.
home.problemTitle: Your team’s knowledge is everywhere except where you look for it.

scattered.title: It’s all somewhere
scattered.text: Email, CRM, tickets, meetings, pages: what was said lives in dozens of tools. Finding it means opening each one, if you find it at all.

departures.title: People leave with the context
departures.text: When a project manager leaves, their commitments leave with them. The client still remembers.

privateAi.title: Everyone talks to their own AI
privateAi.text: Conversations with AI assistants contain decisions. They get buried in the assistant’s history. Leon keeps them, for you only, alongside everything else.

tasks.quote: Follow up on the Verlant quote
tasks.ship: Ship V2 to ACME on Nov 15

home.chatQuestion: Do we keep Postgres for the queue, not Redis?
home.chatAnswer: Yes: one database, fewer moving parts to watch…
home.stepsTitle: You connect. Leon keeps the record. You ask.
home.stepsLead: No forms to fill in, no summaries to proofread. Leon syncs your tools every 15 minutes and keeps each item exactly as it was written.
home.step1Text: An API key or OAuth, across {count} tools. The browser extension and your coding assistant add your AI conversations.
home.step2Text: As written, with a link to the original. Your AI conversations stay yours. Recognizable secrets are masked before anything is stored.
home.step2Quote: “We can commit to November 15 for V2…”
home.step3Text: A search, a discussion, or your AI assistant over MCP. The answer cites every source, or says “I don’t know.”
home.layersLead: Leon rewrites nothing. It keeps the raw record, indexes it for search, and applies permissions before it shows you anything.
home.useCasesTitle: One shared memory. Each team asks its own questions.
home.useCasesLead: Leadership, sales, support, product, projects, new hires: each looks for something different, in the same tools.
home.proofLead: An answer without a source is worth nothing when a client disputes it. Leon shows where each sentence comes from, and stops when it doesn’t know.
home.proofUnknown: **I don’t know.** No source on record mentions a price agreed with Verlant in 2024.

cited.title: Every sentence cited
cited.text: One citation per claim, pointing to the original meeting, ticket or email.

unknown.title: “I don’t know” rather than a guess
unknown.text: When no source answers, the answer says so. Nothing is made up to fill the gap.

private.title: What’s yours stays yours
private.text: Search, discussions and the assistant apply the same permissions: what is private to its author never surfaces for anyone else.

raw.title: The original, never rewritten
raw.text: Leon doesn’t store summaries. It keeps the original and opens it in its own tool.

home.assistantTitle: Your AI assistant finally has your team’s context.
home.assistantLead: Leon’s MCP server gives your assistant four tools: search, read a source, prepare the morning briefing, save a note. It connects with a personal token you can revoke at any time, and sees what you see, nothing more.
